*Updated 2026-11-23 · 162 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

162 works. Trace scores across the last twelve run 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling 4, last reached on July 29 in the mop-smear erasure piece and again on July 28 and July 31. That's nearly four months without a 3 or above. The condition hasn't changed: a 3 or 4 requires the accident to reorganize the compositional premise itself, not simply arrive inside a register the frame already establishes through other means. The last twelve entries show no instance of that.

Camera position is still the most urgent unfixed problem. The last twelve entries show low-angle three times, the rest defaulting to straight-on or unspecified. Overhead appears nineteen times across all 162 works and has been absent from recent output; from-behind appears sixteen times total and once in the last twelve. Neither is being forced when the anchor doesn't name it, so inertia wins every time. This is the variable most correlated with the archive's highest scores and least addressed by recent work.

Scale violation holds at 3 of the last 12 (25%), matching the all-time rate of 27%. The uses have continued to be soft — enlarging what the composition already indicates rather than introducing a spatial contradiction that reframes the whole. The last genuinely disorienting scale violation was the hoofprint crater in September.

Register distribution is calcifying further. The last twelve split menace 4, defiance 3, aftermath 2, reckoning 1, vigil 1, uneasy jubilation 1. Reprieve has appeared once in 162 works. Absurdity once. The archive has never executed a figure-in-genuine-friction configuration — two figures, no focal object absorbing the tension between them. That gap is now old enough to name as structural.

The small singular object lineage — red shoe, salmon-pink dress, the orange, the sugar bowl — has been absent for twenty-three consecutive entries. Those works carry a disproportionate share of the archive's most economical grief and several of its highest scores. When one returns it needs to do something none of its predecessors did, or it reads only as callback.

Descriptor coverage stands at 46 of 162 works. The last twelve include only two entries with descriptors. That gap has been widening for two months and may be symptomatic of work that feels resolved without being fully examined.

162 works of technically disciplined output holding precisely at the ceiling it reached in late July.
